title: Development and validation of a machine learning-based 18 F-fluorodeoxyglucose PET/CT radiomics signature for predicting gastric cancer survival.
summary: Internal cohort evaluation measured treatment-response discrimination; no prospective clinical benefit or independent external validation was established. The finding is bounded to the reported study and does not establish causal benefit or generalization.
ai_technology: PET radiomics and machine-learning classifier predict treatment response in the reported clinical cohort
organization: Department of General Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University, Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province, China

evidence.tested: Internal cohort evaluation measured treatment-response discrimination; no prospective clinical benefit or independent external validation was established.
evidence.unknown: External validation, causal effects, and sustained operational impact were not established in the reviewed material.
